ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement"), made as of June 27, 2018,by and between NORTHEASTERN CONFERENCE HOUSE HOUSING DEVELOPMENT FUND COMPANY, INC., a New York not-for-profit corporation having an address at 115-50 Merrick Blvd., Jamaica, NY 11434 (*FHA Owner") and NORTHEASTERN TOWERS ANNEX L.P., a New York limited partnership having an address at 621 Degraw Street, Brooklyn, NY 11217 (the “LP") and NORTHEASTERN CONFERENCE HOUSE ANNEX HOUSING DEVELOPMENT FUND CORPORATION,a New York not-for-profit corporation having an address at 115-50 Merrick Blvd., Jamaica, NY 11434 (the“HDFC" and together with theLP,the“NewProject Owner"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,the FHA Owner is the owner of certain land located at 131-10 Guy R. Brewer Boulevard, Jamaica, NY 11434, also known as Block 12277, Lot 1 on the Tax Map of New York City, Queens County, and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as the “FHA Project Land"; the improvements currently existing thereupon as of the date hereof, the “FHA Project Building") (the FHA Project Land and the FHA Project Building, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as the “FHA Property"), on which the FHA Owner owns, operates and maintains a multi-family residential building WHEREAS, together, the LP and the HDFC are the owner of the nominal and equitable and beneficial title in certain land located at 161-11 132nd Avenue, Jamaica, New York, designated as Block 12277, Lot 2 on the Tax Map of New York City, Queens County, and more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as the “New Project Land"), together with any building or improvements located or to be located thereon, including the New Project (as defined below) (hereinafter referred to as the “New Project Building" and, the New Project Land and the New Project Building, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as the “New Project Property");the FHA Project Land and the New Project Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the "Parcels" and each individually as a "Parcel"; and WHEREAS, the New Project Owner intends to develop, construct, own, operate and maintain a new mixed use, multi-family residential building comprised of approximately 145,804 square feet of Floor Area (as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution) in the aggregate on the New Project Land (the "New Project"); WHEREAS, the FHA Project Land and the New Project Land are located on single zoning lot (the “Single Zoning Lot") pursuant to that certain Zoning Lot Description and Ownership Statement made by FHA Owner, dated 3/9/2018, recorded 3/14/2018 in CRFN 208000088792;
